findings.friction_name: invite-teammate email link points to a 404 page
findings.narrative: This finding_id is SHAPE-VALID (matches /^fid-[0-9a-f]{16}$/) but WRONG: fid-a3e2967e02bf24b0 is sha256 of the tuple fields in REVERSED order (target|step|tag), independently verified != the correct fid-33382de94ebe9883 that fid- + sha256(heuristic_tag|step|target_element_identifier).slice(0,16) produces for this exact same tuple (see findings-finding-id-formula-a.json). A report-gate.mjs that only shape-checks finding_id (never recomputes sha256) would PASS this — F203/CR9-8 requires the gate reject it, proving the hash is actually recomputed, not merely format-validated.
